reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 13 points better, in a game of about 220 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hornets.
Bottom line: the Lakers win 78 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 194 and 242 total points.

analyst.text: The Lakers have won eight straight but will be without Austin Reaves (heel bruise, third straight absence) and Walker Kessler (lower leg soreness). Luka Doncic is off the injury report despite rolling his ankle in Milwaukee, and this opens a stretch of four home games in seven days. The angle still leans to the Lakers, with less margin than usual.
